wins.text: Achieved $390 million of DRIVE-related cost savings in Q1, broken down as ~$90M surface, $160M air/international, $140M G&A
International export package volumes increased 9% YoY in Q1, driven by International Economy, with continued strength in Asia export market
Completed $1 billion in stock repurchases in Q1 and plans to repurchase an additional $1 billion in Q2
Network 2.0 markets showing ~10% reduction in pickup and delivery costs with service levels meeting or exceeding network average
FedEx Freight revenue per shipment up 2% YoY, demonstrating continued focus on revenue quality in a challenging LTL environment

risks.text: Q1 adjusted operating profit declined $382 million YoY; EPS guidance range narrowed and top end cut from $22 to $21, reflecting weaker-than-expected demand
U.S. Postal Service contract termination creates ~$500 million full-year headwind beginning in Q2, with daytime flight hours reduced ~60%

International export yield pressure now expected to be a $500 million headwind for FY '25, up $100 million from prior expectations, due to mix shift to lower-yielding deferred services and reduced demand surcharges
Weakness in industrial economy pressured B2B volumes; U.S. Manufacturing PMI fell to 47.9, lowest reading of the year, with no significant recovery assumed for remainder of calendar 2024
Purchase transportation expense at Federal Express increased $124 million YoY, driven by International Economy volume growth and commercial air linehaul capacity investment for Tricolor

guidance_items.detail: FY '25 adjusted EPS narrowed to $20–$21 from prior range of $20–$22; top end cut by $1
FY '25 revenue growth now expected at low single digits, down from prior low-to-mid single digits
Federal Express adjusted operating margin still expected to expand YoY for FY '25
FedEx Freight now expected to see modest operating margin decline for FY '25, vs. prior expectations
FY '25 CapEx on track at $5.2 billion, flat vs. FY '24

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Whether FedEx Freight's reported margins accurately reflect stand-alone economics (i.e., intercompany cost allocations vs. true stand-alone burden)
Potential impact of East Coast/Gulf port strike on air freight volumes
Concentration risk and strategic dependency on large Chinese e-commerce shippers (Temu/Shein) for Asia export volume
